svg.title: Plug head length
svg.desc: Two top views of one plate of the two-sided puller, before left and after right, the plug end at the top. Left: the defaults with plug width at the cord end set to 12, a 20 mm wide plug in teal. Right: plug head length at 15 mm. The red line marks the plug's head length and reads 15 mm, the number you type. Marked in red: 1, the teeth: the serrated inner edges of the arms. 2, the zip stations: the three small holes along each arm.
